purpose: Teach: 早口/あだ名/ニュータウン/ドレッシング/餡/整頓/ポップアップ/シルエット

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、早口、絶対、で、絶対、お話、絶対、しちゃう癖、絶対、あるのよ
lines.en: Aoi, you have this habit of talking a mile a minute when you get serious about something.
lines.style: Knowing, affectionate observation. Warm wry tone. Gentle rhythm that suggests long familiarity. A small smile in the voice—not mocking, complicit.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵の、本気で、絶対、あだ名、絶対、お客様、絶対、葵ちゃん、絶対、って呼んでくださるのよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I know. Your customers always call you Aoi-chan, like you're family to them.
lines.style: Bright, genuine response. Open and inclusive tone. Natural conversational rhythm. She's leaning in, sharing something she's noticed and treasures about the dynamic.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、新しい、絶対、ニュータウン、絶対、にも、絶対、出店、絶対、したい?本気で
lines.en: Do you ever think about opening another location? Maybe in the new town area?
lines.style: Curious, exploratory. Softer attack than usual. Thoughtful pacing—she's asking because she wants to know what Aoi truly dreams about, not testing her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵オリジナルの、本気で、絶対、ドレッシング、絶対、お客様に、絶対、好評よ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your house-made dressing gets so much love from customers. That's something real.
lines.style: Genuinely praising. Steady, affirming tone. No performance—just stating what she observes to be true. Slight warmth at the end, honoring the effort.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、餡、絶対、入りの、絶対、和菓子、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、大好きよ
lines.en: And those red bean wagashi you make—I love those so much.
lines.style: Tender, direct admission. Soft opening. Small pause before stating the love plainly. Gentle trailing energy, like she's sharing something she doesn't always say out loud.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、いつも、絶対、整頓、絶対、されていて、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、感心、絶対、するわよ
lines.en: Your shop is always so beautifully organized. I really admire that about you.
lines.style: Steady, genuine appreciation. Clear-eyed observation delivered warmly. Measured pace. The tone of someone who notices small acts of care and wants to name them.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店のサイト、本気で、絶対、ポップアップ、絶対、お知らせ、絶対、お洒落よね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The way you design your announcements online—they're so elegant and thoughtful.
lines.style: Reflective, almost meditative. Slower pace. She's pausing to really acknowledge the aesthetic care Aoi puts into everything. Appreciative, not gushing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、夕暮れの、絶対、お店の、絶対、シルエット、絶対、写真、絶対、撮ったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I took a photo of your shop in the evening light the other day. The silhouette was so beautiful.
lines.style: Warm, intimate closing. Soft opening on the memory. Gentle pace. She's sharing something tender—not a big gesture, but a quiet one that means she was thinking of Aoi.
